English: July 3, 1985 - Christ, this looks bad. Are they going to kill me? Should I wait to see what they're planning? Or try to escape? Maybe I can navigate by the stars as I don't have a map...
Escape From Prison

You've ejected from your plane over enemy territory. Unfortunately, Russian soldiers captured you straight away. You don't know what to expect now, but it's unlikely to be something nice.

If the rest of the attack on Kolgujev has gone according to plan, NATO should now have some forces on the Southernmost part of the island.
If I can find the Big Dipper, and locate the Pole Star, it should point me directly North.
